full_judgment: 2. Briefly stated, the facts are that the respondent No. 2, National Credit and Commerce Bank Limited, instituted a suit being Money Suit No. 13 of 1996 in the Artha Rin Adalat, Khulna. The petitioner appeared in the suit and filed written statement denying the alligators made in the plaint and further asserted that the suit is barred by limitation. Thereafter, on 23-10-1997, the petitioner being defendant filed an application praying for obtaining opinion of handwriting expert on the alleged signature of the defendant appearing on the disputed 9 cheques and some other papers. The learned Judge of the Artha Rin Adalat after hearing, by the impugned order dated 2-9-1998 rejected the application with the finding that the petitioner admittedly did not preserve any pay-in slips and cheques for which it is not possible to compare the statements of accounts with admitted deposit and withdrawals by cheques.
